chunks: From him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from Mālik, the mawlā of al-Ḥakam, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the salat over the deceased has passed you by until he is buried, then there is no harm in praying over him after he has been buried.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the ritual prayer; here, the funeral prayer over the deceased
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can salat over the deceased be performed after burial if it was missed before the burial?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning salat over the deceased. If a person misses the funeral prayer before burial, it is still permitted to perform the prayer after the deceased has been buried.
